method: libfaketime 0.9.10 shifts the whole process clock (including vm contexts); DONT_FAKE_MONOTONIC=1; full suite per offset; base time 2026-11-18 ~15:20 UTC

+3h, +9h, +15h, +21h, +3d, +4d: the task price editor uses the same O$0.1 step that the server enforces
+37d, +44d, +82d, +800d: timestamps show the viewer local date (HK), not the UTC date
+200d, +420d: early-redeemed deposit shows no interest; active deposit shows its estimate

notes: +3d is a Saturday, +37d Christmas Day, +44d New Year’s Day, +82d an HKEX Lunar New Year holiday; +800d is beyond both built-in calendars
